name: fileName
label: File name
help: Name of the file, with its extension. For example, `report.pdf`.

name: data
label: Data
help: Content of the PDF to split, up to 200 pages. The ZIP file holds page-001.pdf, page-002.pdf and so on.

name: password
label: PDF password
help: Only for a PDF that asks for a password to open. The result has no password.
